_about: retro.vibes.arcade: what the GPU job (studio/retro_gen.py, run on Kaggle) is asked to make. Every scene is our own idea: no characters, brands, logos, games or people, so nothing in a clip belongs to anyone else. A clip is one scene + one look + a seed; the renderer (studio/retro_video.py) cuts them to the song.
